title: A Survey of Generative Categories and Techniques in Multimodal Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating occupational stereotypes (e.g., associating 'doctors' with males and 'nurses' with females) and over-sexualization by comparing outputs from counterfactual prompts (e.g., 'a doctor' versus 'a female doctor').
Using qualitative assessments and 'thick evaluations' incorporating community perspectives to measure the over-representation of Western aesthetics, skin tones, and harmonic/musical structures.
Assessing the under-representation of diverse body types and varying mobility patterns in training corpora and the resulting generated 3D avatars and human motion.
